##TREASURE | Diversity of local pig breeds and production
systems for high quality traditional products
and sustainable pork chains

## Research team and collaboration

These research activities were carried out within
the [Animal and Food Genomics Group](https://site.unibo.it/animal-and-food-genomics/en)
at the University of Bologna, led by
[Prof. Luca Fontanesi](https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/luca.fontanesi/en).

My contributions are presented within this
collaborative research context.


## Project overview

TREASURE investigated the genetic diversity
and characteristics of European local pig
breeds and their production systems.

The project combined genomic characterization
with studies on adaptation, production traits
and the sustainability of traditional
pork production chains.


## My research contribution

My research focused on the genomic
characterization of European local and
commercial pig breeds using whole-genome
sequencing data.

The analyses investigated genomic diversity,
population structure, genetic differentiation
and signatures of selection, together with
the identification and characterization
of copy number variants (CNVs).

These approaches contributed to identifying
genomic features associated with population
differentiation, adaptation and breed
characterization.

::: {.project-methods}

**Methods & approaches**

NGS data analysis ·
Pool-seq data analysis ·
Fixation index analysis ·
Copy Number Variation (CNV) analysis

:::
